query: YouGov congressional ballot Democratic lead September 2026

results.content: Democrats continue to lead in voter intent for the 2026 congressional elections, with 46% of registered voters saying they would vote for the Democratic Party candidate for U.S. Congress and 40% saying they would for the Republican candidate. That six-point Democratic lead is the largest on any Economist / YouGov poll since February.
results.title: Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

results.content: Trump’s continued unpopularity could reshape the 2026 midterm landscape. The same Economist/YouGov poll showed Democrats leading Republicans by 5 percentage points on a generic congressional ballot, a trend supported by other recent surveys. An Ipsos/Washington Post poll released July 16 found Democrats leading by 3 points, while a CNBC poll from July 17 showed a 4-point Democratic advantage. Historically, a sitting president’s approval rating serves as a strong predictor of his party’s midterm
